title: From Polyester Girlfriends to Blind Mice: Creating the First Pragmatics Understanding Benchmarks for Slovene

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance on multiple-choice question answering tasks that test pragmatic understanding (e.g., humor, irony, metaphors, and maxims) using scenarios specifically adapted to the target culture (Slovene) rather than direct machine translations of Anglo-Saxon concepts.

Measuring LLM accuracy on nuanced pragmatic benchmarks localized into a smaller, under-resourced language (Slovene), comparing the results of prompts delivered in Slovene versus English, and analyzing the performance gap against human baselines.
